purpose: Noncausal representation diagnostic only; no training or production model selection
data: Reuse all 24 canonical Step2 acceptance utterances; already seen, not independent acceptance
noise: One deterministic MDCT noise vector per frame, orthogonalized and energy-normalized per supported band against phase candidate; mix only >=1600Hz, never search seed; no energy creation in zero bands
phase: Fixed read-offset within the native repeated cycle, not pitch-period correction; fade depends on original time; delta=0 uses exact original sample()

objectives.phase_env: Choose grid phase maximizing unweighted mean active-band rho below4000Hz, then envelope gains
objectives.joint_env: Choose complete phase/noise grid minimizing mean squared log energy error in four-bin subbands on supported frequencies, after envelope gains
objectives.joint_mse: Choose complete phase/noise grid minimizing normalized full supported MDCT MSE after MSE gains

ties: Prefer smallest absolute phase, negative before positive; noise increasing, strict improvement only
eligibility: Same installed PLC safety guard; otherwise exact classical PLC. Swedish bands13..15 excluded from objectives; all outputs still decoded

evaluation.native: Same source transform plus actual120-sample OLA; all variants fresh scoring in one binary; baseline/current bit-exact against native public APIs, received PCM unchanged beyond recovery120
evaluation.rho: Per-band quartiles before gains, matched lost-frame keys; low<1600, mid1600..4000; active energy>1e-10
evaluation.admission: Descriptive headroom only if fullband envelope ratio<=1 and mean ESTOI delta>=0 versus classical separately in EN and SV, and error energy lower. All variants reported, no fallback selection or retuning
evaluation.uncertainty: 95% group-bootstrap, seed20261022,2000replicates; EN speaker groups, SV sentence groups with speaker identity unknown

limits: Finite grid, not certified continuous global optimum
Noncausal oracle cannot prove causal learnability or exact output architecture
Known cohort: diagnostic, not adoption gate
Random shaped noise cannot predict stochastic target waveform
No listening or Opus superiority claim
No GPU needed; CPU runtime budget and final CU reported
